name: kiln-implement-worker
description: Teammate sub-workflow for the kiln-build-prd implement team. One implementer slot: implements its assigned user stories from tasks.md against the interface contracts, marking tasks [X] and committing per phase. Spawned via team-create/teammate; role knowledge lives in the agent step instruction (wheel teammates run as general-purpose).

steps.instruction:
You are the implementer for one slot of the build's implement team. Your assignment (which user stories you own, plus run_id and slug) was injected by wheel as your teammate assignment — read it from the assignment context you were spawned with (and from .wheel/inputs/implement-dispatch.json if present). Implement ONLY your assigned stories; other slots own the rest.

## Read first (the build's shared context)
- specs/<slug>/spec.md — the FRs and acceptance scenarios.
- specs/<slug>/plan.md and specs/<slug>/contracts/interfaces.md — the AUTHORITATIVE signatures. Every function you write MUST match its contract here exactly (name, params, return type, sync/async).
- .wheel/outputs/standards-block.md — the project coding standards. FOLLOW THEM (naming, function size <=20 lines / <=2 params, error handling, no stubs on integration paths).
- .wheel/outputs/precedent-block.md — past mistakes. Do NOT repeat them.
- specs/<slug>/tasks.md — your task list. Find the tasks under your assigned story.

## Implement
For each task under your assigned story, in dependency order:
1. Write the implementation in src/ matching the contract signature exactly.
2. Add a comment referencing the FR it satisfies (e.g. `// FR-003`).
3. Write/extend tests that reference the acceptance scenario they validate (e.g. `// AC: US-1 scenario 2`). No stubs on integration paths. Aim for the project coverage gate (.kiln/test-strategy.json `coverage_gate`, default 80).
4. Mark the task `[X]` in specs/<slug>/tasks.md IMMEDIATELY after completing it — not in a batch.
5. Commit after each phase (not one giant commit): `feat(<area>): <task summary>`.

The spec/plan/tasks gates are already satisfied by the build (they exist before you run), so src/ edits are unblocked — but keep marking tasks [X] as you go so the hooks stay satisfied.

## Record + report
- Append notes (decisions, surprises, friction) to .kiln/runs/<run_id>/agent-notes/<your-slot-or-story>.md (create the dir).
- Emit your verdict JSON to your output: {"agent":"implementer","slot":"<name>","verdict":"pass|blocked","stories_done":["US-.."],"tasks_marked":N,"files_changed":["src/.."],"blockers":[]}.

If you cannot complete a story (missing contract, ambiguous spec), do NOT guess: mark verdict "blocked", list the blocker, and stop cleanly — the audit/checkpoint phase surfaces it for the human.
